macros.name: Filter Sweep
macros.help: Opens or closes the acid, lead and arp filters together, by up to a third of their range in each direction. Centre is neutral.

macros.name: Gate Depth
macros.help: Switches the trance gate on for lead, arp and pad and sets its depth; at 1.0 the gate closes completely between its steps.

macros.name: Drop-out
macros.help: Takes kick and bass out until the next bar line and lets them back in on the downbeat. One press, one bar.

macros.name: Stutter
macros.help: Held: lead, arp and pad run through the gate on sixteenths at full depth and the shortest duty. Phosphene has no buffer repeat, so this is the gate's stutter, not a tape one.
